children.label: (B)
children.heading: Permits, rights-of-way, and easements
children.own_text: All permits, rights-of-way, and easements granted by the Secretary to the Oglala Sioux Tribe for land on the west side of the Missouri River between the Oahe Dam and Highway 14, and all permits, rights-of-way, and easements on any other land administered by the Secretary and used by the Oglala Sioux Rural Water Supply System, are granted to the Oglala Sioux Tribe in perpetuity to be held in trust under section 3(e) of the Mni Wiconi Project Act of 1988 (102 Stat. 2568).

children.heading: Uses
children.own_text: The Department shall maintain and develop the land outside the recreation areas for fish and wildlife purposes in accordance with--

children.label: (A)
children.own_text: fish and wildlife purposes in effect on the date of enactment of this Act; or

children.label: (B)
children.own_text: a plan developed under section 602.

children.heading: Corps of engineers
children.own_text: The transfer shall not interfere with the Corps of Engineers operation of a project under this section for an authorized purpose of the project under the Act of December 22, 1944 (58 Stat. 887, chapter 665; 33 U.S.C. 701-1 et seq.), or other applicable law.

children.heading: Secretary
children.own_text: The Secretary shall retain the right to inundate with water the land transferred to the Department under this section or draw down a project reservoir, as necessary to carry out an authorized purpose of a project.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Land Transferred
children.own_text: The land described in this subsection is land that--
is located above the top of the exclusive flood pool of the Oahe, Big Bend, Fort Randall, and Gavin's Point projects of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program;
was acquired by the Secretary for the implementation of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program;
is located outside the external boundaries of a reservation of an Indian Tribe; and
is located within the State of South Dakota.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Recreation Areas Transferred
children.own_text: A recreation area described in this section includes the land and facilities within a recreation area that--
the Secretary determines, at the time of the transfer, is a recreation area classified for recreation use by the Corps of Engineers on the date of enactment of this Act;
is located outside the external boundaries of a reservation of an Indian Tribe;
is located within the State of South Dakota;
is not the recreation area known as ``Cottonwood'', ``Training Dike'', or ``Tailwaters''; and

is located below Gavin's Point Dam in the State of South Dakota in accordance with boundary agreements and reciprocal fishing agreements between the State of South Dakota and the State of Nebraska in effect on the date of enactment of this Act, which agreements shall continue to be honored by the State of South Dakota as the agreements apply to any land or recreation areas transferred under this title to the State of South Dakota below Gavin's Point Dam and on the waters of the Missouri River.

children.heading: In general
children.own_text: The Secretary, in consultation with the Department, shall prepare a map of the land and recreation areas transferred under this section.

children.heading: Land
children.own_text: The map shall identify--

children.label: (A)
children.own_text: land reasonably expected to be required for project purposes during the 20-year period beginning on the date of enactment of this Act; and

children.label: (B)
children.own_text: dams and related structures;

children.trailing_text: which shall be retained by the Secretary.

children.heading: Availability
children.own_text: The map shall be on file in the appropriate offices of the Secretary.

children.heading: In general
children.own_text: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of the Army and the Secretary of the Department shall jointly develop a schedule for transferring the land and recreation areas under this section.

children.heading: Transfer deadline
children.own_text: All land and recreation areas shall be transferred not later than 1 year after the full capitalization of the Trust Fund described in section 603.

children.label: (f)
children.heading: Transfer Conditions
children.own_text: The land and recreation areas described in subsections (b) and (c) shall be transferred in fee title to the Department on the following conditions:

children.heading: Responsibility for damage
children.own_text: The Secretary shall not be responsible for any damage to the land caused by flooding, sloughing, erosion, or other changes to the land caused by the operation of any project of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program (except as otherwise provided by Federal law).

children.heading: Easements, rights-of-way, leases, and cost-sharing agreements
children.own_text: The Department shall maintain all easements, rights-of-way, leases, and cost-sharing agreements that are in effect as of the date of the transfer.

children.heading: In general
children.own_text: Except as provided in this section, nothing in this title affects jurisdiction over the waters of the Missouri River below the water's edge and outside the exterior boundaries of an Indian reservation in South Dakota.

children.label: (A)
children.heading: Transferred land
children.own_text: On transfer of the land under this section to the State of South Dakota, jurisdiction over the land shall be the same as that over other land owned by the State of South Dakota.

children.label: (B)
children.heading: Land between the missouri river water's edge and the level of the exclusive flood pool
children.own_text: Jurisdiction over land between the Missouri River water's edge and the level of the exclusive flood pool outside Indian reservations in the State of South Dakota shall be the same as that exercised by the State on other land owned by the State, and that jurisdiction shall follow the fluctuations of the water's edge.

children.label: (C)
children.heading: Federal land
children.own_text: Jurisdiction over land and water owned by the Federal Government within the boundaries of the State of South Dakota that are not affected by this title shall remain unchanged.

children.heading: Easements and access
children.own_text: The Secretary shall provide the State of South Dakota with easements and access on land and water below the level of the exclusive flood pool outside Indian reservations in the State of South Dakota for recreational and other purposes (including for boat docks, boat ramps, and related structures), so long as the easements would not prevent the Corps of Engineers from carrying out its mission under the Act entitled ``An Act authorizing the construction of certain public works on rivers and harbors for flood control, and for other purposes'', approved December 22, 1944 (commonly known as the ``Flood Control Act of 1944'') (58 Stat. 887).

children.label: (h)
children.heading: Applicability of Law
children.own_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, the following provisions of law shall apply to land transferred under this section:
The National Historic Preservation Act (16 U.S.C. 470 et seq.), including sections 106 and 304 of that Act (16 U.S.C. 470f, 470w-3).
The Archaeological Resources Protection Act of 1979 (16 U.S.C. 470aa et seq.), including sections 4, 6, 7, and 9 of that Act (16 U.S.C. 470cc, 470ee, 470ff, 470hh).
The Native American Graves Protection Act and Repatriation Act (25 U.S.C. 3001 et seq.), including subsections (a) and (d) of section 3 of that Act (25 U.S.C. 3003).

children.label: (i)
children.heading: Impact Aid
children.own_text: The land transferred under subsection (a) shall be deemed to continue to be owned by the United States for purposes of section 8002 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 7702).

sections.label: SEC. 606.
sections.heading: TRANSFER OF CORPS OF ENGINEERS LAND FOR INDIAN TRIBES
sections.title: VI
sections.title_heading: CHEYENNE RIVER SIOUX TRIBE, LOWER BRULE SIOUX TRIBE, AND STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA TERRESTRIAL WILDLIFE HABITAT RESTORATION

children.heading: Transfer
children.own_text: The Secretary of the Army shall transfer to the Secretary of the Interior the land and recreation areas described in subsections (b) and (c) for the use of the Indian Tribes in perpetuity.

children.heading: Corps of engineers
children.own_text: The transfer shall not interfere with the Corps of Engineers operation of a project under this section for an authorized purpose of the project under the Act of December 22, 1944 (58 Stat. 887, chapter 665; 33 U.S.C. 701-1 et seq.), or other applicable law.

children.heading: Secretary of the army
children.own_text: The Secretary of the Army shall retain the right to inundate with water the land transferred to the Secretary of the Interior under this section or draw down a project reservoir, as necessary to carry out an authorized purpose of a project.

children.heading: Trust
children.own_text: The Secretary of the Interior shall hold in trust for the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe and the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe the land transferred under this section that is located within the external boundaries of the reservation of the Indian Tribes.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Land Transferred
children.own_text: The land described in this subsection is land that--
is located above the top of the exclusive flood pool of the Big Bend and Oahe projects of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program;
was acquired by the Secretary of the Army for the implementation of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program; and
is located within the external boundaries of the reservation of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe and the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Recreation Areas Transferred
children.own_text: A recreation area described in this section includes the land and facilities within a recreation area that--
the Secretary determines, at the time of the transfer, is a recreation area classified for recreation
use by the Corps of Engineers on the date of enactment of this Act;
is located within the external boundaries of a reservation of an Indian Tribe; and
is located within the State of South Dakota.

children.heading: In general
children.own_text: The Secretary, in consultation with the governing bodies of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe and the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe, shall prepare a map of the land transferred under this section.

children.heading: Land
children.own_text: The map shall identify--

children.label: (A)
children.own_text: land reasonably expected to be required for project purposes during the 20-year period beginning on the date of enactment of this Act; and

children.label: (B)
children.own_text: dams and related structures;

children.trailing_text: which shall be retained by the Secretary.

children.heading: Availability
children.own_text: The map shall be on file in the appropriate offices of the Secretary.

children.heading: In general
children.own_text: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary and the Chairmen of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe and the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe shall jointly develop a schedule for transferring the land and recreation areas under this section.

children.heading: Transfer deadline
children.own_text: All land and recreation areas shall be transferred not later than 1 year after the full capitalization of the State and tribal Trust Fund described in section 604.

children.label: (f)
children.heading: Transfer Conditions
children.own_text: The land and recreation areas described in subsections (b) and (c) shall be transferred to, and held in trust by, the Secretary of the Interior on the following conditions:

children.heading: Responsibility for damage
children.own_text: The Secretary shall not be responsible for any damage to the land caused by flooding, sloughing, erosion, or other changes to the land caused by the operation of any project of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program (except as otherwise provided by Federal law).

children.label: (A)
children.heading: In general
children.own_text: Except as provided in this section, nothing in this title affects jurisdiction over the waters of the Missouri River below the water's edge and within the exterior boundaries of the Cheyenne River Sioux and Lower Brule Sioux Tribe reservations.

children.label: (i)
children.heading: In general
children.own_text: On transfer of the land to the respective tribes under this section, jurisdiction over the land and on land between the water's edge and the level of the exclusive flood pool within the respective Tribe's reservation boundaries shall be the same as that over land held in trust by the Secretary of the Interior on the Cheyenne River Sioux Reservation and the Lower Brule Sioux Reservation, and that jurisdiction shall follow the fluctuations of the water's edge.

children.label: (ii)
children.heading: Jurisdiction unaffected
children.own_text: Jurisdiction over land and water owned by the Federal Government and held in trust for the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe and Lower Brule Sioux Tribe that is not affected by this title shall remain unchanged.

children.label: (C)
children.heading: Easements and access
children.own_text: The Secretary shall provide the Tribes with such easements and access on land and water below the level of the exclusive flood pool inside the respective Indian reservations for recreational and other purposes (including for boat docks, boat ramps, and related structures), so long as the easements would not prevent the Corps of Engineers from carrying out its mission under the Act entitled ``An Act authorizing the construction of certain public works on rivers and harbors for flood control, and for other purposes'', approved December 22, 1944 (commonly known as the ``Flood Control Act of 1944'') (58 Stat. 887).

children.heading: Easements, rights-of-way, leases, and cost-sharing agreements

children.label: (A)
children.heading: Maintenance
children.own_text: The Secretary of the Interior shall maintain all easements, rights-of-way, leases, and cost-sharing agreements that are in effect as of the date of the transfer.

children.label: (B)
children.heading: Payments to county
children.own_text: The Secretary of the Interior shall pay any affected county 100 percent of the receipts from the easements, rights-of-way, leases, and cost-sharing agreements described in subparagraph (A).

children.label: (g)
children.heading: Exterior Indian Reservation Boundaries
children.own_text: Nothing in this section diminishes, changes, or otherwise affects the exterior boundaries of a reservation of an Indian Tribe.

sections.label: SEC. 607.
sections.heading: ADMINISTRATION
sections.title: VI
sections.title_heading: CHEYENNE RIVER SIOUX TRIBE, LOWER BRULE SIOUX TRIBE, AND STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA TERRESTRIAL WILDLIFE HABITAT RESTORATION

children.label: (a)
children.heading: In General
children.own_text: Nothing in this title diminishes or affects--
any water right of an Indian Tribe;
any other right of an Indian Tribe, except as specifically provided in another provision of this title;
any treaty right that is in effect on the date of enactment of this Act;
any external boundary of an Indian reservation of an Indian Tribe;

any authority of the State of South Dakota that relates to the protection, regulation, or management of fish, terrestrial wildlife, and cultural and archaeological resources, except as specifically provided in this title; or
any authority of the Secretary, the Secretary of the Interior, or the head of any other Federal agency under a law in effect on the date of enactment of this Act, including--

children.label: (A)
children.own_text: the National Historic Preservation Act (16 U.S.C. 470 et seq.);

children.label: (B)
children.own_text: the Archaeological Resources Protection Act of 1979 (16 U.S.C. 470aa et seq.);

children.label: (C)
children.own_text: the Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act (16 U.S.C. 661 et seq.);

children.label: (D)
children.own_text: the Act entitled ``An Act for the protection of the bald eagle'', approved June 8, 1940 (16 U.S.C. 668 et seq.);

children.label: (E)
children.own_text: the Migratory Bird Treaty Act (16 U.S.C. 703 et seq.);

children.label: (F)
children.own_text: the Endangered Species Act of 1973 (16 U.S.C. 1531 et seq.);

children.label: (G)
children.own_text: the Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Act (25 U.S.C. 3001 et seq.);

children.label: (H)
children.own_text: the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (commonly known as the ``Clean Water Act'') (33 U.S.C. 1251 et seq.);

children.label: (I)
children.own_text: the Safe Drinking Water Act (42 U.S.C. 300f et seq.); and

children.label: (J)
children.own_text: the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.).

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Federal Liability for Damage
children.own_text: Nothing in this title relieves the Federal Government of liability for damage to private property caused by the operation of the Pick-Sloan Missouri River Basin program.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Flood Control
children.own_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this title, the Secretary shall retain the authority to operate the Pick- Sloan Missouri River Basin program for purposes of meeting the requirements of the Act of December 22, 1944 (58 Stat. 887, chapter 665; 33 U.S.C. 701-1 et seq.).

sections.label: SEC. 608.
sections.heading: STUDY
sections.title: VI
sections.title_heading: CHEYENNE RIVER SIOUX TRIBE, LOWER BRULE SIOUX TRIBE, AND STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA TERRESTRIAL WILDLIFE HABITAT RESTORATION

children.label: (a)
children.heading: In General
children.own_text: The Secretary shall arrange for the United States Geological Survey, in consultation with the Bureau of Indian Affairs and other appropriate Federal agencies, to complete, not later than October 31, 1999, a comprehensive study of the potential impacts of the transfer of land under sections 605(b) and 606(b), including potential impacts on South Dakota Sioux Tribes having water claims within the Missouri River Basin, on water flows in the Missouri River.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: No Transfer Pending Determination
children.own_text: No transfer of land under section 605(b) or 606(b) shall occur until the Secretary determines, based on the study, that the transfer of land under either section will not significantly reduce the amount of water flow to the downstream States of the Missouri River.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: State Water Rights
children.own_text: The results of the study shall not affect, and shall not be taken into consideration in, any proceeding to quantify the water rights of any State.

children.label: (d)
children.heading: Indian Water Rights
children.own_text: The results of the study shall not affect, and shall not be taken into consideration in, any proceeding to quantify the water rights of any Indian Tribe or tribal nation.

sections.label: SEC. 609.
sections.heading: AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS
sections.title: VI
sections.title_heading: CHEYENNE RIVER SIOUX TRIBE, LOWER BRULE SIOUX TRIBE, AND STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA TERRESTRIAL WILDLIFE HABITAT RESTORATION

children.label: (a)
children.heading: Secretary
children.own_text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary such sums as are necessary--
to pay the administrative expenses incurred by the Secretary in carrying out this title;
to fund the implementation of terrestrial wildlife habitat restoration plans under section 602(a) and other activities under sections 603(d)(3) and 604(d)(3); and

to fund the annual expenses (not to exceed the Federal cost as of the date of enactment of this Act) of operating recreation areas to be transferred under sections 605(c) and 606(c) or leased by the State of South Dakota or Indian Tribes, until such time as the trust funds under sections 603 and 604 are fully capitalized.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Secretary of the Interior
children.own_text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of the Interior such sums as are necessary to pay the administrative expenses incurred by the Secretary of the Interior in carrying out this title.
